[ASSISTANT_SAID] General advice on retirement planning for someone age 32 includes:  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 1. Start early, stay consistent.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 2. Take advantage of employer matching.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 3. Aim for 10% to 15% of your income.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 4. Consider increasing contributions over time.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 5. Diversify your investments.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 6. Explore other retirement accounts like IRA or Roth IRA.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 7. Create a retirement vision.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 8. Automate your savings.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 9. Monitor and adjust your retirement progress.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 10. Seek professional guidance.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] By age 32, aim to have saved at least 1-2 times your annual income in retirement accounts.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] By age 40, aim to have saved 3-5 times your annual income.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] By age 50, aim to have saved 5-7 times your annual income.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Retirement planning is a long-term process.
